concerns.text: FR-001 (global NOAA NCEP/NCAR pressure data download) is not covered by any task. T002 only fetches a verified *test* pressure dataset; no task implements the required global download, leaving the functional requirement uncovered.

FR-002 (interpolation of coarse pressure fields to a fine‑resolution grid and extraction of nearest grid point) has no matching task. T003’s preprocessing steps omit any interpolation operation, so the requirement is unaddressed.
FR-011 (stratification of control windows by climate indices ENSO/PDO) is deferred in the plan and no task references it; the functional requirement remains orphaned.

SC-004 (computational feasibility measurement) is not explicitly captured by any task. T008 enforces a timeout and memory check but does not record or report actual runtime metrics, so the success criterion lacks a concrete verification step.
